card.name: Second item of a named pair
card.fires_on: The word or word part right after the first of two paired things, where the text is about to relate the two to each other. Examples are the second item after 'and', a hyphen, or 'the two'.

modes.label: Second item after 'and'

modes.label: Hyphenated pair
modes.description: The second half of a hyphenated compound naming two things.
